actionable.summary: Deleted files are assigned the path /dev/null. DiffFile.newPath is /dev/null for a deletion and is truthy, so a remote diff deleting src/old.ts produces a deleted file entry at /dev/null while its fetched src/old.ts comment is placed in a separate synthetic modified entry. The fetch-comments output therefore misrepresents both the materialized diff and its thread placement.

recorded.summary: Fetched review-level and missing-file threads are never added to renderer state. The resume merge only maps over files seeded from the diff and therefore drops every comment whose filePath is the documented empty-string review sentinel, as well as outdated comments for paths no longer in the diff. Remote raster previews read the materialized clone's checked-out working tree, but a temporary clone remains on its default branch and only the PR head ref is fetched. For an image added or changed by the PR, this handler reads the base-branch file (or ENOENT) instead of remoteHeadSha:path. This breaks the explicit full-fidelity image-preview requirement for the standard temporary-clone remote pat

Saving a GUI remote review retains state.source as local git metadata and merely adds remote provenance, so the serializer emits git-diff-args/repository together with remote-url/remote SHAs/remote-forge. The plan defines remote provenance as a third source shape mutually exclusive with local git and directory shapes; every remote GUI save violates that declared document contract.

The welcome-screen remote URL cannot transition the renderer into the returned review. ReviewProvider calls loadDiff only once; its Promise resolves with the startup welcome payload, and the retained onDiffLoad callback can only attempt to resolve that already-settled Promise when main later sends the remote payload.
